subject: Re: Kickoff: environment generation for robust web agents
body:
Hi Ulla,

Staffing: Yara Jokic leads at 50%, Quentin Farkas 40% on the environment-generation pipeline, Halima Toure 30% on agent training.

On human judgments: we're scoping and staffing a human-rating annotation UI from scratch — Vera Egede owns the build at 50%, with Quentin supporting on the trajectory-replay backend — so raters can watch agent episodes and grade them on task completion, efficiency, and safety. I looked and there's nothing in our current tooling that does trajectory-level rating, so we're budgeting it as a ground-up build: first usable version end of June.

Compute: titan-a100 best-effort, 24 GPUs; these agents are small but the curriculum means many parallel environment instances — the cost is CPU-side env serving more than accelerators.

Also filing privacy review early since raters may see generated page content.

Jelena
